$comment: The hourly IG scout's roster — the ONLY copy of this list. ig-party-scout/ig_events.py loads it (there is no SEED_HANDLES in Python any more), so adding a handle here is enough. Loaded and validated by party-scout-agent/source_registry.py. `handle` is the stable id; status 'documented' means deliberately parked and NOT scouted (a handle whose city the site doesn't publish yet). Handles that are also browsable web sources carry `source_id` into data/sources.json. Web sources are a separate list: data/sources.json.
